note: Ground-floor atelier of the Maison de Couture (B62), east of the salon: sage-green wood panelling with white trim, pale limestone floor, fabric bolts. LANDMARK: the gigantic black-and-gold antique sewing machine at the back. Camera faces north: the open doorway in the left (west) wall shows the rose salon with its chandelier and leads back there; the curved white staircase along the right (east) wall goes UP to the navy picture gallery; the back window looks onto the courtyard. Feminine nouns left of x=700, masculine (and élégant) right. Zoom: the cushion-piled window seat under the back window.
